{{Quote|Twin Two will take Red."<br />"Cerise|Captain Syrtik corrects Jagged Fel about the name of Cerise Squadron|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />}}
'''Cerise Squadron''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that was commanded by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] during the [[Battle of Galantos]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The squadron made use at least one [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. When given its role in the Battle of [[Galantos]], [[Jagged Fel]] initially referred to Cerise Squadron as Red Squadron, but was corrected by [[Captain]] [[Syrtik]]. During the battle itself, Cerise Squadron fired [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedos]] into a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[slaveship]], destroying it.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
